facts: There are almost 5 million dog bites per year; children are the main victims. Dog bites cause losses of over $1 billion a year.
Greyhounds are the fastest dogs on earth, with speeds of up to 45 miles per hour.
Davy Crockett had a dog named Sport.
Dogs can see best at dawn and dusk.
Dogs have a third eyelid called a nictitating membrane, which helps to protect their eyes and keep them moist.
